name: PermissionMatrix
intent: A reusable three-level role-permission chooser with a selected-count header, parent/child cascade, indeterminate states, active category navigation, and a coherent equal-track matrix that scrolls as one unit on narrow containers.
when: Creating or editing a role whose permissions are grouped into category, scope, and action levels
A hierarchical permission catalog needs parent cascade and indeterminate checkbox states
Permission labels vary in length but all hierarchy columns must retain equivalent widths
whenNot: Displaying sortable records with independent columns -> use DataTable
Selecting one value from a flat list -> use Select or Combobox
Showing a general-purpose expandable hierarchy without permission cascade -> use TreeRow

chooseOver.because: PermissionMatrix owns cascade logic, indeterminate state, shared column tracks, cell rhythm, overflow, and accessibility so templates do not duplicate or desynchronize them.

categories.note: Three-level category -> group -> permission catalog; leaf permission ids are the selection keys.

value.note: Controlled checked state keyed by leaf permission id.

onValueChange.note: Receives one atomic next value for leaf, group, category, and Select All changes.

activeCategoryId.note: Controlled top-level category displayed in the detail columns.

readOnly.note: Disables permission changes while preserving category inspection.

showHeader.note: Set false when a containing Dialog already owns the title and description.

dataContract.rowIdentity: Permission ids must be unique across the complete catalog; category and group ids must be unique within their levels.

states.default: The first category is active; the header reports selected leaf permissions against the complete catalog.
states.partial: Parent checkboxes use the indeterminate state when only some descendants are selected.
states.selected: Selecting a parent updates every descendant in one value change.
states.readOnly: All checkboxes are disabled while category navigation remains available for inspection.
states.narrow: The matrix retains three equal readable tracks and horizontally scrolls as one unit.
states.empty: The matrix renders Select All disabled with a 0/0 count.

forbiddenPlacement: as a substitute for application navigation

lineage.authoredBy: Extracted from the Admin Panel role setup permission selector (2026-07-19)

extracted: parent cascade and indeterminate checkbox logic

notes: Uses one equal-track outer grid and bounded label truncation to preserve coherent geometry.
